verdict.rationale: Inngest documents a REST API (api-docs.inngest.com), but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on www.inngest.com all returned 404. The llms.txt file, the MCP server and the CLI are adjacent agent-facing features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
